summary: Waterstone Financial, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per common share on September 22, 2026. The dividend is payable November 2, 2026 to holders of record as of October 8, 2026. No stake, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration rather than a special situation. The filing carries no deal terms, no regulatory clock, and no risk-arb angle; the only watch item is continued dividend coverage.
